backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing portfolio data models, admin authentication, CRUD state, and file storage with mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing routes, files, components, and test IDs for recent additions like /scan and /qr.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-style list summarizing frontend files and their roles across layouts, hooks, pages, and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base configuration defining light/dark theme variables and global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document setting metadata, SEO tags, and loading the React application root.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots configuration allowing crawlers except blocking /admin and referencing the sitemap.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: Sitemap listing public site URLs with priorities and change frequencies.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration defining all public and admin routes, including new /scan and /qr.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown when a user without admin access attempts to view protected admin pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminEmailL: Email/password admin login form handling validation, error normalization, and redirecting to intended paths on success.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button that toggles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and automatic retry on auth conflicts.
frontend/src/components/controls/DarkMod: Icon button that switches between light and dark themes using next-themes.
Animated typing/deleting text component cycling through words with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/layout/AdminLayo: Admin layout that guards routes, manages intended redirects, shows navigation links, and handles logout.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer displaying copyright info and a link to caffeine.ai with dynamic hostname.
frontend/src/components/layout/PublicLay: Public site layout wrapping pages with navbar, footer, and SEO manager.
frontend/src/components/layout/PublicNav: Responsive public navbar with navigation links, mobile menu, and dark mode toggle.
frontend/src/components/projects/Project: Project card showing image, metadata, technologies, and links to demo/GitHub.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when it updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGuard.ts: Simple admin guard hook exposing admin authentication status and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminMutations.ts: Defines React Query mutations for admin CRUD actions with error handling and session invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides queries for fetching contact messages and the current admin user profile.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminSession.ts: Manages admin session tokens, validation, login, and logout with shared state and React Query.
Implements a mutation to submit contact messages and refresh related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInitializeSeed.ts: Runs initial seed logic for admin users and invalidates queries after initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for Internet Identity login, logout, and identity state handling.
frontend/src/hooks/usePortfolioQueries.t: Exposes queries to fetch public portfolio data such as about info, skills, projects, and files.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode rules, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page using fetched about and avatar data with loading skeletons.
Admin page to fetch, edit, and save About section content using a textarea form.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminAvatarPage: Provides avatar upload with validation, preview, progress tracking, and display of current avatar.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Dashboard listing admin sections with navigation cards for managing portfolio content.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminExperience: CRUD interface for managing work experience entries via dialogs and forms.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminMessagesPa: Displays contact messages with options to mark as read or delete them.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProjectsPa: CRUD page for creating, editing, and deleting portfolio projects with a modal form.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminResumePage: Provides UI for viewing, uploading, validating, and downloading the admin resume file with progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSkillsPage: Implements skill listing and CRUD operations with dialogs for creating and editing skills.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSocialLink: Manages social link CRUD with a table view and modal-based editing and creation.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: A contact form page with validation, social link icons, and message submission via custom hooks.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePage.tsx: A landing page showcasing services and featured projects with hero, services, and project preview sections.
frontend/src/pages/ExperiencePage.tsx: Displays a timeline of work experiences with loading skeletons and detailed experience cards.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Homepage with hero text, typing animation, project/contact buttons, and resume download handling.
frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: Lists all projects using ProjectCard components with loading states and empty fallback messaging.
frontend/src/pages/QrPage.tsx: Shows a QR code linking to the portfolio along with the destination URL and usage instructions.
frontend/src/pages/ScanPage.tsx: Automatically redirects users to the portfolio URL and displays a temporary loading message.
frontend/src/pages/SkillsPage.tsx: Displays grouped skills by category with loading skeletons and skill level badges.
frontend/src/seo/routeSeo.ts: Defines SEO metadata for public routes and a helper to fetch the correct config.
frontend/src/seo/SeoHeadManager.tsx: Dynamically updates document title, meta tags, canonical links, and JSON-LD based on route, excluding admin and utility routes.
frontend/src/seo/structuredData.ts: Generates JSON-LD structured data for website and person entities and combines them.
frontend/src/utils/adminAuthErrors.ts: Normalizes backend admin auth errors into friendly, generic login messages.
frontend/src/utils/adminRedirect.ts: Handles storing, retrieving, and clearing intended admin redirect paths via sessionStorage.
frontend/src/utils/motokoOption.ts: Unwraps Motoko/Candid option values into null or the inner value.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities to read URL params from query or hash, persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them when needed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, animations, fonts, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, architecture notes, known issues, and existing feature descriptions for the full‑stack portfolio system.
